footer: The broad-classification of the credit scores within different ranges (i.e. excellent, good, needs help etc.) is solely based on the credit report details (and not any other external parameters). The classification is solely Refyne’s opinion for educational purposes and does not guarantee any credit approval from partner and non-partner banks.
